value.rationale: The smallest noncomplete odd-rim wheel is a canonical new test beyond the families classified for strong Morse matching complexes. An exact elementary collapse detects a rank-16 loop space and a full nontrivial dihedral H1 representation with zero global invariants. This distinguishes strong from ordinary wheel Morse topology and provides a reproducible structural datum; it is not an arbitrary graph or a mere Euler-characteristic table.
